corrections_to_prior_evidence.wrong_claim: the Nikki switch block (bNikkiPastelGrade_Active, bNikkiTwinkleIris_Active, bTriplanarPro_Active, bRockDetailAlbedo) is inert because it lives in the false branch of bUseExtendedLayers
corrections_to_prior_evidence.why_wrong: LinearInterpolate_8.A is fed by LinearInterpolate_5 directly, independent of StaticSwitchParameter_2. The pastel grade / ramp chain therefore reaches BaseColor regardless of the switch, just through the A slot. Upstream-ancestry analysis on one pin cannot establish inertness when a branch has consumers outside the switch.
corrections_to_prior_evidence.correct_statement: the switch selects the B slot only (layer substitution). The Nikki grade is always evaluated as the base colour.
corrections_to_prior_evidence.method_rule: a branch is inert only if every node in it has no consumer reachable from the material output outside the switch; ancestry of one pin is insufficient

corrections_to_prior_evidence.why_wrong: get_full_connection_graph models expression->expression edges only. Expression->material-pin edges appear under outputs[].consumers[].material_output, so a node feeding MP_WORLD_POSITION_OFFSET shows out-degree 0.
corrections_to_prior_evidence.correct_statement: StaticSwitchParameter_25 IS the node plugged into MP_WORLD_POSITION_OFFSET. Zero expressions in this material are orphaned.
